title: 3872. Longest Arithmetic Sequence After Changing At Most One Element

examples.explanation: Replace nums[3] = 10 with 3. The array becomes [9, 7, 5, 3, 1]. Select the subarray [9, 7, 5, 3, 1], which is arithmetic because consecutive elements have a common difference of -2.
Replace nums[0] = 1 with -2. The array becomes [-2, 2, 6, 7]. Select the subarray [-2, 2, 6, 7], which is arithmetic because consecutive elements have a common difference of 4.
